metadata.model: 3D inextensible unshearable Kirchhoff strain Ritz; exact SO(3) frame updates and midpoint centerline embedding
metadata.configuration: four Legendre curvature coefficients in each of two bending axes and torsion by default; all are dynamical
metadata.mass: configuration dependent; includes translational and rotary inertia from embedding Jacobians
metadata.KAM_status: Standard nonresonant elliptic KAM is not certified; circular isotropic rod with axial bias has paired bending frequencies.
metadata.relation_to_full_model: Shares material, distal magnet and field interface with the Cosserat model; shear/stretch omitted in this analytical ROM; modal truncation and fluid/contact closure errors are not yet bounded.
metadata.input: 12 total coil currents in A; no separate 8-field increment input or extra ideal bias
metadata.drag: synthetic smooth gamma*P; not a blood/contact closure
metadata.derivatives: double-precision automatic differentiation through full variable-mass SO(3) geometry
metadata.magnetism: Full circular-coil Biot-Savart energy; no additional ideal bias

coil_config.status: Engineering geometry and ratings; unbuilt and uncalibrated air-core coil benchmark

metadata.bias_initialization: Pre-energized fixed local axial-bias fit; not a zero-current startup
metadata.feedback_derivative: Hamiltonian partial z derivative first; compose i(z) afterwards; total field Jacobian contains Di/Dz
metadata.magnetic_domain: Away from ideal circular wires; physical_samples evaluates actual magnet quadrature points only
metadata.constraints: Smooth feedback not automatically bounded; coil_control handles explicit constrained current ramps.

protocol.model: 20-cell actual 12-coordinate 24-phase-space ROM; full variable mass and full 256-point coil quadrature

clearance.scope: straight stress-free reference and clamped root; sufficient theorem, not vascular clearance

limitations: Only 0.897 ms local experiment; no long-time tracking/clearance certification.
Power constraint is imposed at decision state; RK-stage powers are observations, not interval envelopes.
Slew-restricted feasible sets need not include zero; infeasible governor is explicitly tested and rejected.
Moving-point fields sampled at step endpoints; no continuous workspace field bound.
Smooth proportional drag only; unknown blood-flow work, contact, wall motion and microgravity physiology are not activated.
A power governor changes the requested Hamiltonian dynamics and does not imply symplecticity or KAM.
